free_bitcoin_stickers: Zitikiti za Bitcoin zaulere kuchokera ku bitcoin.rocks
stickers_description: Yikani chitikiti cha Bitcoin poyera kuti anthu okhala nawo pafupi aphunzire.
stickers_hero_subtitle: Odolani paketi yaulere ya zitikiti za Bitcoin ndi kuyika poyera kuti anthu ambiri aphunzire za Bitcoin.
stickers_intro_c1: Cholinga chathu ndi kukuthandizani kubweretsa anthu ambiri ku Bitcoin poyika zitikiti za Bitcoin poyera. Zitikiti zathu zonse zili ndi ma QR code omwe amalumikizana ndi masamba ophunzitsa za
stickers_intro_c4: Sankhani paketi ya zitikiti pansipa ndipo sankhani momwe mukufuna kuzilandirira — timatumiza paketi yaulere kwa aliyense ku USA kapena Canada.
stickers_step_1_description: Paketi iliyonse ili ndi mtundu wosiyana wa zitikiti za Bitcoin zokhala ndi ma QR code omwe amaphunzitsa anthu za Bitcoin.
stickers_text_pack_description: Kuphatikiza kwa mawu a Bitcoin ndi mawu omveka opangidwa kuti achititse chidwi pamalo a anthu ambiri.
stickers_signs_pack_description: Zikwangwani za chenjezo, zoopsa, ndi zomanga ndi mauthenga a Bitcoin — zopangidwa kuti zikope chidwi ndikupangitsa anthu kuyimirira ndikuwerenga.
stickers_vote_pack_description: Zitikiti za USA okha zomwe zimatsogolera anthu ku voteforbetter.money — tsamba lathu lomwe limafotokoza chifukwa Bitcoin ndi ndalama yabwino kwambiri kwa Aamerika.
stickers_vote_panel_note_after: , tsamba lathu lomwe limafotokoza chifukwa Bitcoin ndi ndalama yabwino kwambiri kwa Aamerika.
stickers_vote_print_c1: Mukhozanso kulowa nawo posindikiza nokha zitikiti ngati simukufuna kupempha paketi yaulere. Dinani pansipa kuti mutsitse mafayilo a zitikiti za Chingerezi ndi malangizo a kusindikiza.
stickers_step_2_description: Tikutumiza paketi yaulere ku adilesi za USA ndi Canada. Kulikonse padziko lapansi, mukhoza kusindikiza nokha kapena kuodola zambiri.
stickers_instructions_1: Lembani adilesi yanu yotumizira ndipo tikutumiza Paketi yaulere ya Zitikiti za Bitcoin pa makalata. Zitikiti zanu zikufika mu envelopi yoyera.
stickers_instructions_2: Deta ya adilesi imachotsedwa zitikiti zanu zaulere zikatumizidwa.
stickers_print_c1: Mukhoza kulowa nawo posindikiza nokha zitikiti, kulikonse komwe muli. Dinani pa chilankhulo chanu pansipa kuti mutsitse mafayilo.
stickers_print_c2: Si chitikiti chilichonse chimapezeka mu chilankhulo chilichonse.
stickers_request_c1: Dzazani fomu yomwe ili pansipa kuti mupemphe mafayilo a zitikiti mu chilankhulo chanu cha m'derali. Tikukuuzani akakhala okonzeka.
stickers_bulk_c2: Odolani zambiri kuchokera kwa wosindikiza yemwe ife timagwiritsa ntchito
stickers_bulk_c3: — zambiri mukagula, zochepa mtengo wake pa chitikiti chilichonse.
stickers_share_c1: Gawanani malo anu a zitikiti nafe pa Nostr ndipo muone kumene anthu ena akuyika zitikiti zawo.
stickers_flyers_link_before: Pomwe mukuyenda, sindikizani ndi kuyika nokha
stickers_flyers_link_after: kuti muthandize kubweretsa anthu ambiri ku Bitcoin.
stickers_next_print_flyers_desc: Sindikizani mapepala aulere a Bitcoin oyikira poyera
